about.text: "Gotland Blue" is made in Sweden by the Arla Foods company in the town of Stånga on the island of Gotland. This cheese is often characterized as being somewhere between strong and mild, containing elements of both types. The color is a pale yellow, and it has no holes.

sources.text: NOT a blue-mould cheese: pale yellow, no holes, Emmentaler-like texture, cube in blue wax (Swedish colours); Arla, Stånga; discontinued 2004
